divergences.upstreamResult: DragOverlay treats every function child as a render prop and invokes it with the active source.
divergences.octaneResult: DragOverlay distinguishes Octane compiled children blocks via isChildrenBlock and only invokes plain render-prop functions.
divergences.rationale: Octane compiler children blocks are functions; calling them as render props would execute the wrong arm.
divergences.consumerImpact: Ordinary typed JSX children and render props remain equivalent; bare Function children that are compiled blocks render as children rather than render props.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Pass a plain (source) => node render prop when dynamic overlay content is required; keep static overlay children as elements or values.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane stops representing compiled children as functions or adds a React-compatible children channel.

divergences.upstreamResult: useSortable defaults include SortableKeyboardPlugin and OptimisticSortingPlugin, which reparents the host element before application state commits.
divergences.octaneResult: useSortable defaults keep SortableKeyboardPlugin but omit OptimisticSortingPlugin; explicit plugin arrays remain authoritative.
divergences.rationale: Optimistic host reparenting can split an Octane keyed item's owned DOM marker range before the consumer commits list state.
divergences.consumerImpact: Default sortable moves wait for consumer state updates instead of optimistically moving the host element.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Update list state from drag events so Octane performs the keyed move; pass an explicit plugins array if OptimisticSortingPlugin is required.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane gains a safe optimistic DOM move for keyed ranges or if upstream stops defaulting OptimisticSortingPlugin.
